title: norite about --json
description:
The machine-readable output of `norite about` (M20a): AGPL section 5(d)'s Appropriate Legal Notices for this build, and the section 13 source offer of the instance its daemon is signed in to.

Versioned source of truth (CLAUDE.md rule 15): a change to what this command prints ships with a change to this file in the same commit. Two programs and two obligations, kept apart: `build` describes the binary that printed this, stamped into it; `instance` is the server's own offer, and its strings are a stranger's, escaped where a terminal would act on them.

version.description: This build's release version, or `dev` for a build nobody stamped.

revision.description: The git commit this build was made from, or `unknown`.

revision_from.description: Where the revision came from: stamped at link time, read from the toolchain's record of the checkout it was built in, or not known.

modified.description: True when the toolchain recorded uncommitted changes in that checkout, so the revision is where the source started rather than all of it. Always false unless revision_from is `vcs`.

source_url.description: Where this build's source can be had: upstream, unless the build that made it said otherwise.

license.description: The license the instance's own code is under.

source_url.description: Where the instance's source can be had.

source_revision.description: The revision the instance's server was built from.

instance.description: The instance's own offer, through the daemon, or null when it could not be asked.

instance_unavailable.description: Why the instance could not be asked, or null when it was.

rights.description: What the license lets anybody do with the program.

warranty.description: That it comes with no warranty.

terms.description: Where the license's full terms are.
